name: Naqsha
summary: Housing society desk: clickable plot map, plot files with transfers, instalment plans and recovery
about: A property dealer and housing scheme desk for a Pakistani society. A blueprint-style site plan shows every plot by block and status, each plot file keeps the owner and transfer history, instalment plans track paid, due and overdue amounts with late surcharge, and receipts print with the amount in words in PKR. Built for site offices and property dealers.
how: Open the Plot map: blocks draw themselves and plots fill by status. Filter by status or size, zoom with the buttons (or Ctrl + wheel) and drag to pan.
Click an available plot to book it on the monthly plan or full payment; click a sold plot to open its file.
In a file, see the paid ring, owner, masked CNIC and ownership history. Transfer the file to a new owner (only when no dues are pending) and print an allotment letter.
Open Instalments to see the full schedule for a file, then Receive payment to make a receipt that prints with the amount in words.
Recovery shows due vs collected by month, overdue aging and defaulters; tap Remind to open a ready WhatsApp text (wa.me link) or print a notice.
Change the down payment, number of instalments, possession share, surcharge and base prices in Settings.
